ambiguities: PRB-004: whether a pointer click on "Try again" gives the button focus is a platform matter. If it does not, focus could stay "none" instead of moving to the place title by FOC-1.
CRY-3/WEB-4 carry-to: it is not stated whether a card whose middle is exactly at the pointer counts as "above", or whether the positions use the layout after the carried card is shown.
MOV-2 "same position number": it is not stated whether this is the position among the visible cards or in the whole column.
History depth after Back: the spec counts entries but does not say how a Back changes the reported depth.
contradictions: Notice.Error face has a second action "Dismiss", but the note under BLK-4 says "A notice has at most one action."
